styles.dark: Anime cel-shaded game prop in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colour areas, bold clean dark outlines, hard-edged two-tone cel shading with a bright cool-white rim light on the lit edges, natural local colours (rust brown, steel grey, faded red, teal, warm yellow) kept clearly lighter than a dark navy night background, small neon cyan and magenta accents, straight-on orthographic side elevation with no perspective, one single object centered, no ground, no cast shadow, no text.

props.prompt: A heavy industrial gantry crane seen from the side: wide steel girder bridge on two tall legs with a trolley and hanging hook, rust and yellow-black hazard stripes on the legs, small red warning lights on top.

A cantilever jib crane: a tall steel lattice column on the left and a long horizontal lattice boom extending to the right with a trolley, a chain and hook hanging near the right end, a red warning light at the boom tip, rusty and oily.

A battered industrial forklift truck seen exactly from the side, forks raised, driver cage with a roof, small solid wheels, dull faded safety-yellow paint with heavy rust and scratches, a red warning beacon on the roof.

An industrial control console desk seen from the front: a sloped panel with two small glowing cyan and green monitor screens, rows of buttons, switches and a few red indicator lights, a chunky grey steel housing with cable bundles.

A heavy steel security blast door closed, seen from the front: riveted double sliding door panels with a vertical centre seam, a thick steel frame, yellow-black hazard stripes along the bottom, a red status lamp above the door.
Two rusty corrugated shipping containers stacked on each other, seen flat from the side: dull blue lower container and faded red upper container, peeling paint, closed doors, no logos.
A stack of wooden freight pallets with a few shrink-wrapped cargo boxes on top, worn and dirty, seen from the side.
A section of intact rusty chain-link fence between two steel posts with a top rail, seen flat from the front.
A small prefab corrugated steel worker cabin with a door, a window lit with warm yellow light, a small air conditioner and a pipe vent on the roof, seen flat from the front, rusty and stained.
Five thick black industrial power cables hanging in loose loops straight down from a single horizontal mounting rail at the top, with cable clamps, seen from the front.
A rooftop water tower: a wooden-slat barrel tank on a rusty steel four-leg frame with cross braces and a small ladder, a conical metal lid, proportions about five wide to seven tall.
A tall thin steel lattice radio antenna mast with cross-bars, small dishes and cables, seen from the side, a red aircraft warning light at the very top.
A satellite dish on a short rusty pole bracket, dish tilted up and facing right, with a feed arm and cable, weathered, seen from the side.
A rooftop ventilation stack: a vertical galvanised steel pipe with a rain cap on top, pipe clamps and a bent elbow at the bottom, dented and weathered.
A short thick old brick factory chimney, sturdy and wide, its width about half of its height, with a concrete cap and a short rusty metal flue on top, soot stained, seen from the front.
A small rooftop maintenance shed with corrugated metal walls, a slanted roof with vents, a door and a window lit with warm light, seen flat from the front, weathered.
Three industrial oil drums standing side by side, one rusty red, one faded blue and one olive green, dented steel with ribbed rings, seen from the side.
A weathered street bench with wooden slat seat and backrest and cast iron legs, seen from the side.
A large dented green steel dumpster bin with a hinged lid, wheels and forklift pockets, rust streaks, seen from the side.

A Japanese street drink vending machine seen from the front: glowing lit front panel with rows of colourful drink cans, a coin slot and a pickup slot, rain-wet and slightly rusty, glowing cyan and pink.

A city bus stop shelter seen from the front: steel frame with a glass back panel and roof, a glowing advertisement light-box panel on one side showing an abstract neon picture, a metal bench inside, standing on thin steel legs, cleanly cut out with nothing below the frame.
A large rooftop LED billboard seen from the front: dark steel frame on two support legs, a big glowing screen showing a colourful abstract neon advertisement with no readable text.
A horizontal neon sign: a dark metal box board with glowing magenta and cyan neon tubes forming abstract kanji-like shapes, mounted on two small brackets.
A neon sign: a vertical sign board with glowing magenta and cyan neon tubes forming abstract kanji-like shapes, mounted on a bracket, dark metal frame.
A string of seven red paper lanterns hanging from a sagging rope, each lantern glowing warm red-orange, seen from the front.
A rooftop clothesline between two thin poles with a sagging line and several hanging clothes: shirts and towels in muted dull colours, seen from the front.
A spray-painted graffiti mural of a stylised fluorescent magenta and cyan face and abstract shapes on a dirty concrete wall panel with ragged torn edges.

A street noodle food stall: a wooden cart with a striped red-and-cream fabric awning along the top, a steaming pot, hanging paper lanterns, a counter with bowls, the front of the cart made of plain dark brown wooden planks, warm light.
A shop awning: a ribbed striped canvas awning on metal brackets, teal and cream stripes with a scalloped edge, seen from the side.

The front of a building's exterior fire escape: two separate horizontal landings stacked one above the other, each landing with a railing of vertical bars, connected by one diagonal stair with a handrail, rusty brown iron, lighter than a night sky, wall brackets, about two wide to three tall.
A vertical steel wall ladder: two rails, evenly spaced rungs and wall brackets, rusty, tall and narrow.
A triangular yellow and black hazard warning sign with an exclamation mark on a short steel post, a small red warning lamp on top, scratched and rusty.

A holographic data terminal: a low dark metal console base with a small projector on top, above it a glowing translucent cyan hologram display with floating wireframe interface panels, graphs and a small rotating globe.
